items.title: Warrants used to search Andrew's homes were unlawful, court says
items.summary: A criminal investigation into the former prince continues and police have retained material seized from his homes.

items.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and Thames Valley Police agreed warrants to raid two properties were unlawful
items.summary: A High Court judge has said Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and Thames Valley Police have agreed the search warrants that allowed officers to raid two of his properties earlier this year were…

items.title: Two men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
items.summary: Police say they apprehended the suspects at about 02:00 while they were inside the perimeter.

items.title: Two Latvian nationals arrested on suspicion of trespassing at RAF base
items.summary: Two men have been arrested on suspicion of breaching the perimeter fence at an RAF base used by NATO and US military intelligence.

items.title: Three sisters who drowned in sea off Brighton took own lives, inquest finds
items.summary: Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters, who lived in London, drowned in the sea in May.

items.title: Royal Navy serviceman accused of plotting to leak intelligence to Russia appears in court
items.summary: A junior Royal Navy serviceman accused of plotting to leak classified information to Russia has appeared in court.
